summary_1line: Bhishma outlines ethical and practical duties of kings—protection of subjects, secrecy of counsel, righteous conduct, wise advisors, and just governance.

image_candidates.scene_text: A cruel prince throws children into the flowing Sarayu while horrified townspeople watch from the riverbank.
An aged king sits beneath a royal umbrella surrounded by loyal ministers while spies whisper reports in the shadows of the court.
A just king stands before peaceful citizens who walk fearlessly through a prosperous city under his protection.
